sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOBBIES_1_173' AND s.state_id = 'CA' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date)::date ORDER BY ds ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the total sales (y) for product HOBBIES_1_173 in state CA, aggregated quarterly (quarter granularity). The resulting time series will be used to forecast the next 3 quarters.
